claims.statement: Optimizing rank via singular value truncation improves INR reconstruction fidelity on signal fitting benchmarks.
claims.details: Singular value truncation applied to INR weight matrices yields higher PSNR across standard test images compared to baseline unregularized INRs.

claims.statement: The rank-optimization objective introduces a low-rank regularization term that bounds effective spectral norm.
claims.details: Implementation of low-rank penalty in loss function constrains spectral norm while maintaining reconstruction accuracy.

claims.statement: Rank-optimized INRs achieve faster convergence rate during early-stage gradient descent optimization.
claims.details: Convergence metrics show 20% fewer iterations needed to reach target MSE threshold under rank optimization.

claims.statement: The proposed method is robust across diverse activation functions including SIREN (sine) and Wire (gabor).
claims.details: Ablation tests confirm consistent performance gains with both sine and complex Gabor activation functions.
